summary.motive: Outflank aggressive defenses by combining pre-snap orbit motion and a rapid perimeter toss with multiple pulling lead blockers.
summary.whyItWorks: Pre-snap orbit motion distorts secondary coverage leverage. The quick toss gets the ball past the line of scrimmage in ~1.0s, allowing the pulling H-back and motion receiver to overwhelm edge run support.
summary.failureMode: A fast-flowing nickel/overhang shooting the backfield gap, or defensive line penetration disrupting the toss.

beats.title: Fast Orbit Motion & Formation Distortion
beats.text: Speedy Z receiver sweeps in fast orbit motion behind the QB right at snap, pulling secondary eyes and creating immediate +1 numerical leverage to the perimeter.

beats.title: The Quick Perimeter Pitch & Toss
beats.text: QB executes a quick reverse pivot and pitches the ball out to the sprinting RB, getting the ball to the edge faster than the front seven can scrape.

beats.title: The H-Back Lead & Crack Block Combo
beats.text: H pulls around the tight end and destroys SS in the alley, while the motion receiver Z cracks down on RCB to create a massive sideline runway.

beats.title: Turning the Corner into Green Grass
beats.text: RB follows the lead escort past the numbers, turning the corner into open space with only the deep safety left to pursue.

beats.title: Explosive Perimeter Chunk
beats.text: RB bursts 15+ yards down the sideline, punishing defenses trying to overplay Kubiak’s inside split-zone actions.

relations.tell: Z runs pre-snap orbit motion behind the QB to distort secondary fits before snap.
